data.gender_notes: Numaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Prophet Numaan was a just and righteous ruler. He provided relief to his people during times of hardship. Numaan's name is derived from the Arabic word 'numan' which means 'to ease, relieve, or alleviate.'. The name Numaan carries the meaning “Reliever of Hardship” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Numaan usually hope their child will grow to embody reliever of hardship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
